corrections.sourceText: They took for themselves wives of the women of Moab. The name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other was Ruth. They lived there about ten years.

after.reasonJa: 妻を迎えたtheyは1:2–3で名が示された二人の息子。オルパ/ルツとの個別対応を推定しない。

corrections.sourceText: They took for themselves wives of the women of Moab. The name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other was Ruth. They lived there about ten years.

after.reasonJa: Naomiの名が決意を見て勧めをやめた人物として明記される。

corrections.sourceText: When Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.

after.reasonJa: Ruth the Moabitessというモアブの民に関わる呼称を明記。族祖個人の用例ではない。

corrections.sourceText: Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor.” She said to her, “Go, my daughter.”

after.reasonJa: Ruthのmother-in-lawは1:22/2:6で明らかなナオミ。夫の個別名マフロンはここでは推定しない。

corrections.sourceText: Boaz answered her, “I have been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, and how you have left your father, your mother, and the land of your birth, and have come to a people that you didn’t know before.

after.reasonJa: ナオミが語るher daughter-in-lawは直前2:19以来のルツ。

corrections.sourceText: Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “May he be blessed by the LORD, who has not abandoned his kindness to the living and to the dead.” Naomi said to her, “The man is a close relative to us, one of our near kinsmen.”

after.reasonJa: Ruth the Moabitessは民に関わる呼称の明記。モアブという男性個人の発話ではない。

corrections.sourceText: Ruth the Moabitess said, “Yes, he said to me, ‘You shall stay close to my young men until they have finished all my harvest.’”

after.reasonJa: ボアズが近い親族について応答する相手は3:9以来のルツ。無名のより近い親族に名前を作らない。

corrections.sourceText: Now it is true that I am a near kinsman. However, there is a kinsman nearer than I.

after.reasonJa: Ruth the Moabitessが明記される。地理的なモアブ国内を指す文ではない。

corrections.sourceText: Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi, you must buy it also from Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance.”

after.reasonJa: Ruth the Moabitessが明記される。個人ルツに付された民の呼称として区別する。

corrections.sourceText: Moreover, Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance, that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place. You are witnesses today.”

after.reasonJa: your house/youは4:11から続く祝福の受け手ボアズ。

corrections.sourceText: Let your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, of the offspring which the LORD will give you by this young woman.”

after.reasonJa: this young womanは4:11の家に来る女性、4:10で名が明記されたルツ。
